# A2A v1.0.1 wire fixtures

These minimized JSON fixtures are pinned to the normative protocol model at
`a2aproject/A2A` tag `v1.0.1`:

- <https://github.com/a2aproject/A2A/blob/v1.0.1/specification/a2a.proto>
- <https://github.com/a2aproject/A2A/blob/v1.0.1/docs/specification.md>

They preserve the normative ProtoJSON member names and oneof shapes needed by
the connector contract tests. They intentionally omit optional values unrelated
to response projection and contain no production or third-party data.
